changes.content:
networks:
  1panel-network:
    external: true
services:
  pgvector:
    command:
    - postgres
    - -c
    - shared_preload_libraries=vector
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: ${CPUS}
          memory: ${MEMORY_LIMIT}
    environment:
    - TZ=${TZ}
    - POSTGRES_USER=${PANEL_DB_USER}
    - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PANEL_DB_USER_PASSWORD}
    - POSTGRES_DB=${PANEL_DB_NAME}
    - POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS=--encoding=UTF8
    healthcheck:
      interval: 10s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U "$$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$$POSTGRES_DB" || exit 1
      timeout: 5s
    image: pgvector/pgvector:0.8.5-pg18-trixie
    labels:
      createdBy: Apps
    networks:
      1panel-network:
        aliases:
        - ${CONTAINER_NAME}
    ports:
    - ${HOST_IP}:${PANEL_APP_PORT_TCP}:5432
    restart: always
    volumes:
    - pgvector_data:/var/lib/postgresql
    - ./initdb.d:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
volumes:
  pgvector_data: null

version: latest
additionalProperties:

    en: PostgreSQL vector similarity search extension for embeddings storage.
  type: tool
